pages.name: Sicilian: 2.d3 Nc6
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed f4-f5 from a King's Indian Attack with the knight on f3 blocking the f-pawn. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling elsewhere.

pages.name: Sicilian: 2.g3
pages.notes: Plan 2 had Black play ...d6 and then ...d5. Rewrote plan 2; British spelling in the overview. Plan 1 (Re1 before castling) is fixed in the follow-up in batch 2026-11-16-6 (reviewer: the first draft had c3 covering d5).

pages.name: Sicilian: English, 2...Nc6 3.Ne2
pages.notes: Plan 4 named f5 and h5 as moves rather than squares; plan 1 wrote Nc3 where both knights can reach c3. Rewrote plans 1 and 4; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Sicilian: Wing Gambit, Marshall Variation, 3...d5!
pages.notes: Plan 3 gave Black an isolated queen's pawn after ...Qxd5 (there is none); plan 1 used an a-file that is still closed; plan 4 claimed a central pawn majority. Rewrote plans 1, 3, 4; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Slow Sicilian
pages.notes: Overview and plan 1 described a King's Indian Attack with Bg2 when the bishop already stands on e2. Rewrote overview and plans 1 and 4; British spelling in plan 2.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Smith-Morra Gambit Accepted, Larsen Defense
pages.notes: Plan 3 rerouted the f3-knight via e1 to g2 for no clear purpose. Rewrote plan 3 around the open c-file and the half-open d-file; British spelling elsewhere.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Smith-Morra Gambit Accepted, Siberian Variation, Siberian Trap
pages.notes: Plan 3 attacked a d6-pawn that isn't there; plans 1-2 described the trap loosely. Rewrote plans 1-3 around 9.h3? Nd4! 10.Nxd4 Qh2 mate; British spelling in plan 4.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Smith-Morra Gambit Declined, Alapin Formation
pages.notes: Plan 1 supported an e5-pawn not yet there and challenged a Nd5 that isn't there; plan 2 'controlled d4' after White recaptures there. Rewrote plans 1-2; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Sicilian: Grand Prix, 2...e6
pages.notes: Plan 3 wrote the queen lift as Qe1-h4 before castling. Rewrote plan 3; British spelling elsewhere.

pages.name: Sicilian: Grand Prix, 2...Nc6
pages.notes: Plan 1 wrote the queen lift as Qe1-h4 before castling. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling in plan 4.
